sources.title: Kimi K2.5 | Open Visual Agentic Model for Real Work
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.5: AI That Sees, Codes, and Works Like an Expert Discover Kimi K2.5, a powerful open source multimodal model built for real-world work. It turns text and visuals into production-ready code, powers agent swarm workflows, and delivers expert-level results through a single unified model.

sources.title: Kimi AI Models: See What Each One Can Do
sources.snippet: Explore Kimi's latest AI models, compare their capabilities and strengths, and find the right model for coding, research, creation, and complex work.
